description: Use this when a user asks what Arc & Ledger charges, or wants a price estimate for tax preparation, bookkeeping, business formation, or IRS help. Returns a published price range and line items, never a single committed number, plus what is included and the next step by complexity.

entity_type.description: Entity type for a business return or formation.

foreign_accounts.description: Number of foreign financial accounts (triggers FBAR/FATCA and cross-border scoping).

k1s.description: Number of K-1s received (individual) or issued (business).

states.description: Number of states to file BEYOND the first (each additional state).

unfiled_years.description: Number of past-due / unfiled years (triggers multi-year scoping).

language.description: Language for an availability or waitlist handoff: English (en), Turkish (tr), or Spanish (es).

service.description: The kind of work you want priced.

relay.description: Instruction to the calling assistant: relay figures and dates verbatim (identical on every response).
